description: MCP interface for the Modular Monolith topology. Provides tools for inspecting and validating modular monolith configurations, resources for manifest and ruleset access, and prompts for monolith-governed implementation and extraction-readiness guidance.

tools.name: evolith-topology-inspect
tools.description: Inspect a Modular Monolith topology configuration and return its parsed manifest, module boundaries, and corpus artifact references.

configPath.description: Path to the Modular Monolith configuration file

includeModules.description: Include module boundary and ownership metadata

tools.name: evolith-topology-validate
tools.description: Validate a Modular Monolith configuration against the topology ruleset and OPA policies, returning pass/fail per gate.

configPath.description: Path to the Modular Monolith configuration to validate

strictMode.description: Fail on warnings, not just errors

resources.name: Modular Monolith Topology Manifest
resources.description: Full topology manifest for Modular Monolith, including metadata, artifact references, and corpus configuration.

resources.name: Modular Monolith Rulesets
resources.description: All ruleset files for Modular Monolith: native rules JSON, OPA Rego policies, and WASM bundle.

prompts.name: topology-aware-implementation
prompts.description: Guides AI-assisted implementation to respect Modular Monolith topology constraints, bounded context isolation, and shared kernel rules.

prompts.name: extraction-readiness-review
prompts.description: Evaluates whether a modular monolith module is ready for extraction into a distributed service, checking coupling, ownership, and contract boundaries.
